high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news report with a black background and white text. The text reads: "BREAKING: An assassination attempt against President Trump was recorded on live TV as he was speaking at a campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania. The President flinches and grabs his ear before diving behind cover. Multiple follow up shots are heard snapping through the air. Aftermath photos show Trump raising his fist to the crowd as well as being escorted away by Secret Service. Blood can be seen running down the side of his head.
